newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to weaken.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to weaken.

text.p: Cash bids for millfeeds continued to slide Thursday in reaction to ample feed supplies in most areas of the country, dealers said.

Availability of winter wheat and falling corn prices have provided livestock producers a menu of low-cost feed, dealers said. Also, hot weather in much of the country has lessened livestock feed consumption, thus slowing feed usage.
Dealers shipping millfeeds to the Southeast said sales remain steady to the catfish industry, but were slow to poultry and hog sectors.
Minneapolis sources reported a $3.00 to $4.00 per ton drop in prices today and in southern California prics were down $7.00 to $8.00.
